name: sorceress_generate_sound_effect
description: Generate a sound effect from a text description (e.g. 'sword unsheathing', '8-bit coin pickup', 'rain ambience') with BytePlus Seed Audio 1.0 and save the mp3 into the project (default assets/sorceress/audio). Billed at 1 credit per second of finished audio (min 1), charged to the API key owner only on success. Waits for completion and returns the saved file path.

prompt.description: Description of the sound effect. Max 1800 chars.

targetDuration.description: Approximate length in seconds (1-120). Default 3. Billed 1 credit per second of finished audio.
